tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbang bzhi'i dus dang mtshan ma bstan pa'i phra ṭig

dbang chen thabs kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang gi phra ṭi ga rnam par phye ba/ rnam par dag pa gsal ba yi/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'jug tshul gyis/ / rig pa gsal ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /de la slob dpon slob ma yi/ /'brel ba rnam dag gsal ba'i phyir/ /slob dpon dag gi mtshan nyid bshad/ /dag cing dbang po ma nyams dang*/ /mang du thos shing nga rgyal zhi/ /tshul 'chos spangs shing chog shes dang*/ /rgyud la goms shing nyams su len/ /lta ba rtogs shing 'dzin chags chung*/ /bya ba nyung zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /rmongs pa med cing chog shes dang*/ /yang na sdom pa gsum la gnas/ /dka' thub ldan zhing mchog la sbyor/ /nags khrod brten pa'i bla ma la/ /nor ni gser dngul rang lus tsam/ /gyur ltas yang nas yang du 'bul/ /de ltar mtshan nyid rdzogs pa yi/ /bla ma dbang bskur cho ga ni/ /lo bdun lnga dang gsum sngon du/ /ji ltar bzhed pa'i yon phul la/ /zhu ba dag ni lan gsum dbul/ /rta dang glang po rin chen g.yu/ /'bru dang sman la sogs pa yi/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pa/ /bla ma mnyes phyir phul la zhu/ /bla mas slob ma'i snod yang brtag /dad ldan gtong phod che ba dang*/ /'byor ldan yo byad gtong bar nus/ /thabs ldan bla ma'i bya ba mkhas/ /sdom ldan dam tshig sbyar bar nus/ /khro med dregs tshig spangs pa dang*/ /'jam zhing ngang tshul des pa dang*/ /yid dal spyod pa mkhas pa ni/ /slob ma'i mtshan nyid yin par 'dod/ /'di lta bu yi slob ma la/ /dbang bskur nas ni gdams par sbyin/ /gal te sgrub la brtson pa ni/ /rang gi zas dang gos sbyar la/ /bsgrub pa nyams su len du gzhug /'di ltar su yis byas pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung las ma 'das so/ /'di lta bu yi dpon slob gnyis/ /'dzom pa tsam las dngos grub ni/ /gang 'dod 'byung bar the tshom med/ /sku gsum sa la mnyam sbyar ro/ /des n-i bla ma slob ma yi/ /mtshan nyid gsal bar bshad pa'o/

/da ni dbang bskur 'jug dus bshad/ /spros bcas dbang gi dbang bskur ni/ /bya ི ba 'brug dang rta dang phag khyad par lo ni bzhi dag la/ /dbang bskur cho ga 'grub pa yin/ /zla ba ra ba bzhi dag la/ /dus tshogs 'bras bu 'byin phyir 'grub/ /tshes grangs yar gyi gcig nas ni/ /zla ba tshes kyi mtshams su gdon/ /bskur dus nyin phyed nam gung ngo*/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi bye brag gis/ /so so'i 'byung ba'i lo la sbyar/ /dbang bskur cho ga shis par 'gyur/ /'di dus slob ma dam tshig can/ /'byung ba'i lus rnams mthun pa ni/ /grangs la dpag tshad gzung du med/ /brgya'am bcu bdun la sogs pa'i/ /'byung ba las mthun 'gal ba med/ /gal te cho ga la zhugs tshe/ / mar me mdangs dang mi ldan na/ /dam tshig bskang ba'i cho ga bya/ /sme ba med na dngos grub ni/ /yang nas yang du blang bar bya/ /don med shi na bar chad 'byung*/ /dbang chog 'dzab la drag tu 'bad/ /de tshe 'dus pa'i mched lcam kun/ /lus la nad nyid byung ba na/ /phyag dang bskor ba dag bya 'o/ /ngag la bslab 'chol su la byung*/ /bsam te yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ /sems ni nyog gam dran nyams na/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim la 'jug /gal te byang ba'i rtags byung nas/ /gdod kyis dbang bskur cho ga 'bad/ /gal te bsgrub pa'i rdzas 'phel na/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob pas na/ /mnyam pa'i don la mos par bya/ /dbang bskur cho ga la zhugs nas/ /rtag tu mtshan ma mthong gyur na/ /thun mong dngos grub de yis 'grub/ /nyams dang shes par ldan na yang*/ /'dis kyang dga' bde nyid la spyod/ /bla ma nyid la mchog tu yang*/ /mos pa bzang po su bskyed pa/ /'dis kyang phyag rgya mchog la sbyor/ /bdag nyid lus ngag bde mthong na/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas zhing dag go /spros bcas dbang gi dus dang yang*/ /mtshan ma dag ni la ེ gas bshad do/ /da ni spros pa med pa yi/ /dus dang mtshan ma nyer bstan bya/ / 'di la lo yi bye brag med/

/gang la yang ni shis pa 'o/ /phyi dus dbyar dang dgun la bzang*/ /tshes grangs yar gyi ngo la 'o/ /bskur dus tho rangs sgra spangs pa'o/ /'di la dad ldan lnga dang drug /bdun las mang na don mi 'grub/ /de ltar dad dang ldan pa'i bu/ /sems kyi las su dge ldan pa/ / ngag gi snga ma'i bstod ldan pa/ /de lta bu la dbang bskur tshe/ /lus ni bde ba ma yin na/ /lus kyis phyi nas bshags pa bya/ /de bzhin ngag dang sems la yang*/ /sdig pa bshags pa'i las brtsam mo/ /spros pa med pa'i dbang bskur gyi/ /dus dang mtshan ma bshad pa 'o/ /da ni shin tu spros pa med/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dbang bskur gyi/ /dus dang mtshan ma bshad par bya/ /'di yang lo yi bye brag min/ /rang thad nyid du byas pas 'grub/ /phyi dus sa bon 'a ju ga pa'i dus/ /byang chub sa bon bstan pa'i phyir/ /'di yi dus su dbang bskur na/ /sa bon gang zhig 'phel bar bshad/ /'bru dang 'bras bu sdud dus su/ /shin tu spros med dbang bskur na/ /ye shes 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /sku gsum sa la nges par 'gro/ /nang dus yar ngo'i 'phel dus la/ /tshes grangs mar ngo 'grib spangs pa'i/ /nyams myong brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /nyams dang byin rlabs gong du 'phel/ /bskur dus nyi ma rtse shar la/ /rang byung ye shes shar don du'o/ / yang na mar gyi zad mtshams su/ /rtog pa zad pa'i don du'o/ /skal ldan gcig gam yang na gnyis/ /gsum las mang na don mi 'grub/ /'di dus so so'i phyogs bzung ste/ /lus kyi dus na nam mkha' la/ /sprin dang khu rlangs kha char dang*/ /rlung la sogs pa'i sgra dag dang*/ /g.yul nyes dgra dang chom rkun dang*/ /mi sdug pa yi gzugs byung na/ /lus kyi sdig pa che bas na/ /phyi nang dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /snga mas gdams pa ma bstan par/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ /rang gi snga ma'i gzims khang la/ / bskor ba 'bum phrag drug dag gam/ /phyag kyang 'bum phrag gcig tu bya/

/de dus mtshan ma'i khyad par ni/ /thog ma yod la tha ma bar/ /nges pa'i mtshan ma gzugs dag nas/ /lus kyi spyod pa 'byongs pas na/ /phyi nas 'bad pa bya mi dgos/ /gal te tha ma dag byung na/ /lha yi sku ni stong phrag sgom/ /de nas snga ma'i man ngag ni/ /rim pa dag la bslab par bya/ /ngag g-i dus na'ang de bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas shes par bya/ /'di yang thog ma med la bar du byung bas na/ / bshags pa'i las ni yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag gcig /'bad dang bcas pas bzlas par bya'o/ /gal te tha ma byung ba na/ / gsang sngags rgyud sde rang lo'i grangs/ /brgya ni rtsa brgyad klog par bya'o/ /thog mtha' bar med dus rnams su/ /rgyud klog pa dang sngags bzla dang*/ /bla ma yi dam lha dag gi / bstod tshig sna tshogs brjod pa dang*/ /a li ka li'i yi ge bgrang*/ /so sor rkyang pa brjod pa dang*/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang oṃ dang ni/ /sbrel ma sna tshogs brjod pa la/ /zla ba bdun du 'bad par bya/ /de nas gdams pa'i gnas su bya/ /sems la thog mar gang byung na/ /yi dam lha yi ting nge 'dzin/ /nyi ma gsum du bsgom par bya/ /gal te bar du byung ba na/ /sngags kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ /nyi ma bdun du 'bad par bya/ /tha mar byung na yi ge yi/ /'phro 'du dag ni bsgom pa la/ /nyi ma bcu yi bar du 'bad/ /thog ma bar mtha' kun byung na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa 'am/ / ngag las byung ba'i bsam gtan la/ /bsgom pa zla ba drug tu 'bad/ /gal te lus ngag sems kyi ni/ /spyod pa so so'i dus su yang*/ /nam mkha' sngo sangs sprin dang bral/ /rlung dang ser bu sgra med par/ /'jam zhing 'jam pa dag byung na/ /sdig pa dag ni sbyang mi dgos/ /gal te thog mar yod pa la/ /so so'i mtha' mar dag snang na/ /'di ni sdig pa 'byongs pas na/ /bshags pa'i cho ga mi dgos so/ /de bzhin lus ngag sems dag ni/ /so so'i ngos bzung mkhas pas brtag /de ni shin tu spros pa med/

/ bang bskur cho ga'i dus dang yang*/ /mtshan ma brtag pa bshad pa'o/ /re zhig dbang thob mtshan ma ni/ /rig pa'i me tog gtor dus su/ /lus ni g.yo dang drag tu 'phar/ /lus la byung na lus kyis thob/ /ngag gi sgra skad sna tshogs pa/ / 'byin zhing chos rnams smra ba dang*/ /ngo mtshar chos rnams brjod pas na/ /de bzhin du yang ngag gis thob/ /sems la ting 'dzin babs pa dang*/ /g.yengs shing dran pa nyams pa dang*/ /sems kyi dbang bskur thob pa 'o/ /gal te lus kyis thob nas ni/ /sprul pa'i sku nyid 'di yis thob/ /de bzhin ngag la longs sku 'o/ /sems ni chos sku'i zhing du 'gro/ /shin tu spros med dus mtshan bshad/ /rab tu spros pa med pa yi/ /dus dang mtshan ma nges bstan bya/ /phyi dus 'bras bu smin pa'am/ /'bru rnams bsdu ba'i dus la gtad/ /rang snang 'bras bur grol phyir ro/ /nang dus yar ngo'i tshes gcig gam/ /yang na zad pa'i mtshams la gtad/ /thig le nyal gcig rtogs nas ni/ /las dang bag chags rang zad phyir/ /skal ldan gcig las mang na yang*/ /rnal 'byor pa yis don mi 'grub/ /dad ldan yid du 'ong ba'i bu/ / skal ba ldan pa gcig la bskur/ /gnyis kar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ / gdon mi za bar 'gyur bar nges/ /bskur dus nyi ma rtse shar la/ /so so'i tshig gis nges gsal bas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi mthong ba'o/ /'di la mtshan ma ci byung yang*/ /sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga med/ / gong du thad kar sbyang ba'i phyir/ /gal te sprin med nam dngas na/ /chos kyi sku yi zhing la spyod/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis mdangs shar na/ /'di ni longs sku'i zhing du 'o/ /sna tshogs sgra rnams grags pas na/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin no/ /gal te skal dang ldan pa zhig /'di dus lus gnad mkhas pa dang*/ /de las g.yo ba med pas na/ /lo bdun gyis ni zad sar phyir/ /ngag gis brjod pa stor gyur na/ /'dis ni zla ba nyer gcig na/

/chos nyid zad pa'i sa la phyin/ / sems la mkhas shing rlung stongs na/ /zla ba bdun na skal ldan 'di/ /snang ba thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /gal te blo rtsal rab rnams la/ /dang po sgros bcas brtsams nas ni/ /bar ma chad pas rim gyis kyang*/ /yang dag rdzogs par byed pa'i lugs/ /mchog tu gyur pa rnams la te/ /'di ni shin tu dkon pas na/ /zhag dang zla ba lo yi bar/ /rang gi nyams dang sbyar la ni/ /dbang bzhi dag ni rdzogs par bskur/ /gal te dbang bzhi ma rdzogs na/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang*/ /zab mo'i chos bshad rtogs yul nyid/ /'di nyid bskur bas dbang thob bo/ /slob ma'i mtshan nyid rab brtags la/ /gnyis dang gsum la sogs pas ni/ /slob ma'i 'byor pa'i tshad dang sbyar/ /bla ma rang gi nyams myong gis/ khyad par dus ni mchog nges bshad/ /bu la nus pa 'jug don du'o/ /zhes dbang rnam par bkod pa'i phra ṭika /dbang gi rim pa rnam par phye ba las/ rnam par dag pa gsal ba'i dum bu rim par 'jug pa'i thabs bstan pa ste gnyis pa rdzogs so// //spros bcas kyi dbang bsdus pa ni lce btsun gyis mdzad do/ /spros med/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med gsum la/ sprul pa po dga' rab rdo rje'i rtsa ba dang*/ bi ma la'i de gsal byed la sogs dum bu drug yod pa rnams bsdus nas/ lag len bde bar rang byung rdo rjes byas so/ /dbang bzhi'i dus dang mtshan ma 'di ni/ bi ma las mdzad pa'o/ /rdzogs chen snying tig la dbang gi rnam grang mang yang 'di rnams su ma 'dus pa med do/ /kye ma rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs mar phyin/ /thabs mkhas zab pa'i gdams pa dpag med kyang*/ /shes pas mi chog gter gyi kha byang 'dra/ /des na brtson bskyed 'jig rten bya ba thong*/ /rang rig ye shes gter dang ma phrad par/ / lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs nyams su longs/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
